atlasDraft.pZh: 回廊钟第37年，门都合上了。门槛上留着一枚旧铜扣。阿沉没有认领它。收音人把它放进空匣，匣底响了一下。
atlasDraft.pEn: In the 37th year of the Corridor Bell, the doors had all closed. An old brass button lay on the threshold. A Shen did not claim it. The sound-collector placed it in an empty box. Something sounded once at the bottom.
